description: 행정안전부_지방재정365_회계별 지방채 잔액 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 주된 발행목적은 사회기반시설에 대한 투자, 재해복구나 긴급자금수요 대응, 재정운영의 균형확보, 지역경제 활성화를 위한 정책재원의 확보 등을 목적으로지방재정법 제11조(지방채의발행),. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 지방재정통계, 자치단체통계, 결산, 채무현황, 회계별지방채잔액. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
